title.narrative: Sustainable dried mango export in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: Berrico FoodCompany BV, a worldwide active importer specialised in processed (organic) plantspbased food products based in the Netherlands, with support from theSubsidy Programme for Responsible Business (SPVO) Programme for Responsible Business, has launched a new initiative to strengthen ethical and sustainable business practices across Burkina Faso’s dried-mango sector. Berrico has partnered with two female-owned suppliers in Burkina Faso—Mango-So and ABASF — who produce high-quality dried mango for export to the Euopean Union EU and support hundreds of farmers and workers.Burkina Faso is one of Europe’s leading supplier of dried (organic) mango, and demand is rising. The partners see a clear opportunity to make sure that this growth becomes a virtuous circle — where better working conditions lead to stronger businesses, stronger businesses can invest more in their people, and the benefits of progress flow back into families, communities, and the sector as a whole.To build this virtuous circle, the programme looks closely at the real experiences of people along the supply chain. It aims to surface the challenges that are often difficult to see: health and safety issues, the pressures on women balancing factory work and home responsibilities, and the barriers that prevent women from moving into leadership roles. By listening to workers, farmers and managers — and by spending time in both factories and orchards — the partners aim to understand what needs to change for growth to be fair, safe and sustainable.A central aim is to test practical solutions that are good for people, good for business, and good for the environment — from approaches that improve job quality and wages to changes that help factories become more efficient, greener and more reliable. By openly sharing what works, the programme hopes to give other companies the confidence to adopt similar improvements, helping to raise standards across the industry.This initiative reflects Berrico’s belief that strong supply chains are built on strong relationships. With Economic Sense and RBE-RSE providing hands-on technical support — from audits and dialogue to action-plan design and day-to-day coaching — the programme is designed to deliver practical, lasting improvements that benefit people, communities and the future of Burkina Faso’s dried-mango sector.
